observations: Increasing actual axis density from 49 to 65 lowers median and p90 error only modestly.
p99 error is nonmonotone and becomes slightly worse.
maximum error remains essentially unchanged and the same off-grid dry-to-wet endpoint pair remains dominant.
Table bytes rise by approximately 76 percent between these two points while the tail error blocker remains.
The evidence so far is inconsistent with rapid monotone convergence required to justify brute-force quadratic density growth.
methodological_rule: Do not close C4 until the precommitted 81- and 113-node points and the second material class complete. Do not promote any density from this revealed characterization without a new holdout.
